title: NADI, a new DARPA-like Dutch government agency, launches a €40M challenge to accelerate chip design with AI in collaboration with its German counterpart SPRIND (Toby Sterling/Reuters)
summary: Toby Sterling / Reuters: NADI, a new DARPA-like Dutch government agency, launches a €40M challenge to accelerate chip design with AI in collaboration with its German counterpart SPRIND — A new Dutch government agency set up to achieve strategic innovation will work with its German counterpart to pursue breakthroughs …
